title: Pay with the airline card (the page's own card form)
caption: `src/pages/checkout-pay-airline.js` + `lib/card-brand.js` (OADR-0017, ota/docs/flows/checkout-airline-card.md). The card lives only in the inputs and in one request body; the API wraps it in a SensitiveCard and forgets it at the end of the request.

steps.label: GET /v1/storefront (no-store), GET checkout, GET payment
steps.note: Ids from the address only; nothing from sessionStorage/localStorage. The form shows only when supportedMethods lists airline_card and airlineCard.enabled.

steps.label: types holder, number, expiry, security code
fee + total the airline charges → button "Pay €…"
local checks: holder, Luhn, expiry, CVC length, accepted brand
steps.note: A typing mistake is never sent, so it never costs one of the three attempts.

steps.label: POST /v1/checkouts/{id}/airline-card-completion (new Idempotency-Key per submit, 90 s, never retried)
idempotency (hash without card), lock checkout, booking pending
Flight Create Orders issue=true, formOfPayments creditCard
booking ticketed, payments captured (card_brand, card_bin, card_last4 only)
